description: Data disks of a machine: filesystem, mount point and ownership, or a raw block device.

fields.description: Append an /etc/fstab entry for every non-raw mount so it survives a reboot of the stand.
fields.name: fstab
fields.title: Persist in /etc/fstab

fields.description: One entry per data disk of this machine. Filled by the server from topology.
Block device path. Filled by the server from topology (the provisioned disk of this machine).
fields.name: device
fields.title: Device

fields.description: No filesystem: the device is given to the engine as a raw block device (YDB pdisk). mount_point/fs/mkfs_options are ignored.
fields.name: raw
fields.title: Raw device

fields.description: Absolute directory the filesystem is mounted at.
fields.name: mount_point
fields.title: Mount point

fields.description: Filesystem created on the device. xfs is the default for database data volumes.
fields.name: fs
fields.title: Filesystem

fields.description: Extra flags passed to mkfs.<fs>. Empty means the distro defaults.
fields.name: mkfs_options
fields.title: mkfs options

fields.description: Comma-separated mount(8) options. noatime/nodiratime remove a write per read.
fields.name: mount_options
fields.title: Mount options

fields.description: chown argument for the mount point, "user:group".
fields.name: owner
fields.title: Owner

fields.description: Octal chmod mode for the mount point.
fields.name: mode
fields.title: Mode

fields.name: mounts
fields.title: Disks

computed.expr:
("mounts" in root) ? root.mounts.map(m,
					m.raw
						? "# raw device, no filesystem\nblkdiscard -f " + m.device + " || true"
						: "mkfs." + m.fs + " " + m.mkfs_options + " " + m.device + "\n" +
						  "mkdir -p " + m.mount_point + "\n" +
						  "mount -o " + m.mount_options + " " + m.device + " " + m.mount_point + "\n" +
						  "chown " + m.owner + " " + m.mount_point + "\n" +
						  "chmod " + m.mode + " " + m.mount_point +
						  (root.fstab
							? "\necho \"" + m.device + " " + m.mount_point + " " + m.fs + " " + m.mount_options + " 0 2\" >> /etc/fstab"
							: "")
				).join("\n\n") : ""

fields.description: Derived: the shell fragment that prepares every disk.
fields.name: script
fields.title: Provisioning script
